_comment: The one place a model gets its colour. `slots` is the fixed categorical order (CSS --s1..--sN in site/lib/bench.css; validated with the dataviz palette checker, adjacent pairs, light and dark; the first four also pass all-pairs, which is what the cost scatter needs). `models` pins a model family to a slot number for good: a new model gets the next free slot appended here and never moves anyone else. A family missing from this map is a build warning and lands on a slot derived from its name hash, so it is stable too, just not chosen. No slot is red or near red: red is reserved for the silent-failure outcome.
